{{Quote|You are most gallant, citizen. What is your name again? I want to name my new kittle in your honor.|A kittle owner, to a spacer|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''kittle''' (plural: '''kittles''') was a small [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Feline/Legends|felines]] kept as personal companions or house pets. They were regarded as cute, and had a [[Cat/Legends|cat-like]] growl. Through the process of [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]], [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] were able to incubate kittles by using their [[DNA/Legends|DNA]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|I love animals, I really do. Why, the times I've diverted my speeder to avoid hitting some harmless eopie or cute little kittle&mdash;even though it delays my courier mission, mind you, and my employers really don't like delay&mdash;well, I admit, I'm a softie.|An unidentified Corellian|<ref name="AED" />}}
Kittles were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]]<ref name="JTL" /> [[Feline/Legends|felines]]<ref name="COA" /> notable for their cuteness,<ref name="HardLine">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission Terminal: "Take Hard Line Against Animals" on Corellia</ref> and [[Cat/Legends|cat-like]] growl.<ref name="COA" /> They had wrinkly skin<ref name="JTL" /> which could come in a variety of different hues, including shades of [[Color/Legends|red]], yellow and blue. The [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[vertebrate]]s<ref name="COA" /> also had black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], short stubby [[Ear/Legends|ears]],<ref name="JTL" /> and a long [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]]<ref name="TCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Beast Empathy}}</ref> and tail.<ref name="JTL" /> Though kept as pets,<ref name="Avenge">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission NPC: "Avenge Woopywoopums"</ref> they were also known to run wild.<ref name="HardLine" /> When under attack, kittles would bite and claw back to defend themselves.<ref name="COA" />

==History==
[[File:BeastEmpathy.png|thumb|A young Twi'lek and his kittle]]
{{Quote|My precious little kittle&mdash;she liked to be called Woopywoopums&mdash;was snatched by a horrible predator while slithering playfully in my yard. Please avenge my angel for me.|A kittle owner|<ref name="AED" />}}
Through the use of their [[DNA/Legends|DNA]], kittles could be incubated and trained by [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast masters]] as personal companions or house pets.<ref name="COA" /> During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="AED" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a predator snatched a kittle named [[Woopywoopums]] while [[Gender/Legends|she]] was slithering playfully in her owner's yard. Saddened by the loss of their pet, the owner sought to hire a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate a lair of beasts believed to be responsible for the kittle's demise.<ref name="Avenge" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
One spacer agreed to eliminate the lair, and for their part in avenging the kittle, the pet owner wished to name a new kittle in honor of the gallant citizen.<ref name="Avenge" />
{{Endgame}}
Another owner, a young male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], kept a kittle as a pet, for which he displayed a strong bond and a great deal of empathy.<ref name="TCG" /> One [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] animal lover was known to go out of their way to divert the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] they were driving to avoid hitting any wild kittles.<ref name="HardLine" /> On the other hand, a very well armed and murderous religious cult was known to sacrifice kittles and [[Gnort/Legends|gnorts]] as part of their rituals. Deeming lawful punishment impossible, a concerned citizen sought to hire a strike team to demolish their temple and put an end to their "evil" practices.<ref name="Evil">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission NPC: "Evil Cult"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Listen|filename=Cr-kittle-vocalize.flac|title=Kittle vocalization|description=The growl of a kittle {{C|''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''}}}}
[[File:Kittle_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Kittles were first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Early in the game's lifespan, dynamically spawned non-player characters offered a variety of simple [[W:c:swg:Quest|missions]].<ref name="AED" /> In one case, NPCs could offer a destroy mission titled "Avenge Woopywoopums," the storyline of which featured a kittle. The mission required the player to destroy [[W:c:swg:Creatures & enemies|creatures]] at an assigned [[W:c:swg:Waypoint|waypoint]] in exchange for a [[W:c:swg:Imperial Credit|credit]] reward.<ref name="Avenge" /> Another NPC mission titled "Evil Cult" mentioned kittles,<ref name="Evil" /> as did a [[W:c:swg:Mission Terminal|mission terminal]] quest titled "Take Hard Line Against Animals."<ref name="HardLine" /> A kittle was first pictured in the [[2004]] strategy book ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide]]'',<ref name="JTL" /> and again in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]].<ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

However, kittles were not actually included in [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] until the release of [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="COA" /> The update introduced [[W:c:swg:Collection|collections]], a type of system which would track discoveries and kills, and award the player with [[W:c:swg:Badges|badges]] and/or other types of rewards for completion.<ref name="Chapter7">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=66959&resource=publish#chapter7|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> One such collection, titled "[[W:c:swg:Rodent Eradicator|Rodent Eradicator]]," would award the player with a badge and rare kittle [[W:c:swg:DNA|DNA]] once completed. The DNA could then be [[W:c:swg:Incubator Unit|incubated]] by [[W:c:swg:Beast Master|beast masters]], allowing for kittles to be created as [[W:c:swg:Pets|pets]].<ref name="COA" /> According to the game's directory tree files and source data, there were to be at least two other separate breeds of kittle known as the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] kittle and [[Grass/Legends|grassland]] kittle,<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref> however neither of these were known to appear on the live servers.<ref name="AED" /> In ''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'', the fifth expansion of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]'' released on [[December 15]], [[2009]], a kittle received an illustration in a game [[W:c:swg:Card list|card]].<ref name="TCG" />
